why: Helstrom's anchor stands inside the grove. The last 400 m of the Onkobra reach crosses six shallow bars. The convoy berth is where the reach last floats a laden boat, 474 m out along the lane; a piled pier and a raised root causeway carry the arrival 222 m to the east gate.

Lilmoth's anchor sits inland, on the firm ground that carries the city; no hull or lighter reaches it. The lighter quay at the pier head is the channel-head berth for which every lane into Lilmoth makes, so the lanes end there and the quay lane carries them into the city.
